to: Grievance Officer, Suraksha Health Insurance Co. (demo)
subject: Request for explanation of deductions – Claim CLM-2026-0083412
body:
Dear Sir/Madam,

Policy number: XXXX-XXXX-4821
Claim number: CLM-2026-0083412
Patient: Kamala Sharma
Hospital: City Care Hospital, Pune (admitted 18 Aug 2026, discharged 22 Aug 2026)

I have received your settlement letter dated 20 Sep 2026. Of the claimed amount of ₹2,46,000, ₹2,08,000 was approved and ₹38,000 was deducted. I request clarification on the following:

1. Other deductions – ₹9,500
The letter does not give a reason or a policy clause for this amount. Please share the list of bill items included and the clause relied on.

2. Room-rent and proportionate deduction – ₹21,600
Please confirm the room category considered eligible, and the list of "associated medical expenses" used under Clause 5.3, as the clause does not list them fully.

3. Non-payable consumables – ₹6,900
Please confirm that only items listed in Annexure II have been deducted.

The documents listed in the evidence index are attached. Please reply with the requested details.

Yours faithfully,
Ravi Sharma (on behalf of Kamala Sharma)
Phone: [your phone number]
Email: [your email]
evidenceIndex: Policy wording – Clause 3.2 (page 7), Clause 5.3 (page 11), Annexure II (page 38)
Hospital note on room availability (to be obtained)
